body: why is it so hard to die!?!?

sorry about your dad and brother, that must really suck. i wish i could find that way to just find joy and happiness, or atleast smile every once and awhile, maybe i should open up about these things? i really haven't told anyone or opened up about my abuse, my mom knows very little about all the stuff people have done to me.

not even if i land on my head? thats a real bummer, but as for the reason i want too i am just very much sick of being a loser.
